**Finding: Compliant** (RENEWAL — Auto-renewal and non-renewal notice window)

The renewal package in §§ 8.1–8.3 sits at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback:

- **Renewal term** — successive twelve-month periods (§ 8.2); no automatic multi-year rollover.
- **Notice window** — thirty days' written notice from Customer, well inside the preferred ≤ 30 days.
- **Reminder** — Vendor must remind us at least sixty days before renewal, and failure to do so extends our opt-out deadline to thirty days after the reminder arrives. That extension mechanic is better than the playbook asks for.
- **Price uplift** — capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent (§ 8.3), matching the preferred cap, plus ninety days' notice of any increase and no increase on prepaid periods.

The three-year initial term in § 8.1 is a negotiated committed term rather than an automatic multi-year renewal, so it does not implicate the walk-away trigger. No redline proposed.
